paragraph_1: SpaceX launched the Falcon 9 rocket on Tuesday. The rocket carried 60 Starlink satellites into low Earth orbit. Elon Musk founded SpaceX in 2002 with the goal of reducing space transportation costs.
paragraph_2: SpaceX successfully deployed a batch of 60 Starlink internet satellites aboard its Falcon 9 booster. The launch took place from Cape Canaveral. SpaceX, led by CEO Elon Musk, aims to provide global broadband coverage through its Starlink constellation.
paragraph_3: Elon Musk announced that Starlink has surpassed 1 million active subscribers worldwide. The service uses a constellation of low-orbit satellites to deliver high-speed internet. SpaceX plans to launch thousands more Starlink satellites in the coming years.

paragraph_1: Scientists at MIT discovered a new method to convert carbon dioxide into useful chemicals using a copper catalyst. The process could help reduce greenhouse gas emissions significantly.
paragraph_2: Researchers from MIT have developed a copper-based catalyst that transforms CO2 into ethylene, a valuable industrial chemical. The breakthrough offers a potential pathway to reduce atmospheric carbon dioxide levels.
